description: Describe what Sequenzy's integration providers do, whether or not they are connected. For each provider: category, how it connects, what it syncs, every event it emits with the real-world moment that triggers it, the subscriber attributes it writes, supported actions, availability, and caveats. Use this to answer 'what would connecting Stripe give me?', to compare providers before recommending one, or to check whether an event a sequence needs actually exists for that provider. Coverage differs sharply between providers - only Shopify has storefront browse tracking, and only Stripe, Chargebee, and RevenueCat cover the full trial lifecycle - so check here rather than assuming.

category.description: Filter by category: payments, ecommerce, auth, analytics, ads, affiliate, cms, crm, developer.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

provider.description: Only return this provider, for example `stripe`, `shopify`, `clerk`. Omit to list every provider.
